title: Gotrade Daily: Yields at 2002 Highs as PepsiCo Reports
summary: US Treasury yields hit their highest since 2002 as Fed minutes signal another hike. Tonight: PepsiCo earnings. Watchlist: PEP, MU, XOM, LULU.
body_markdown:
## Tonight's Watchlist


Stock Movement What to Watch


[PEP](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/pep/) -1.58% Wednesday at $123.73 Reports earnings before the US open. Watch the results and company guidance.


[MU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) +4.06% Wednesday at $1,088.00 Samsung reported preliminary Q3 operating profit of 107.4 trillion won. Watch how US memory stocks respond.


[XOM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/xom/) -0.26% Wednesday at $164.05 Oil is rising on Middle East tension. Watch oil prices tonight.


[LULU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/lulu/) -1.85% Wednesday at $91.88 Hired Athleta CEO Maggie Gauger as president and chief product officer. Watch the market's response.


Source: closing prices from[Nasdaq](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks) . What to Watch:[Nasdaq](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/earnings) and[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/07/stock-market-today-live-updates-.html) (PEP),[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/08/samsung-q3-earnings.html) (MU),[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/08/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-hormuz.html) (XOM),[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/08/fed-hike-inflation-samsung-lululemon-iea-oil.html) (LULU).


## Tonight's Key Events


### PepsiCo earnings


**PepsiCo ([PEP](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/pep/) )** reports third-quarter results before the open, according to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/07/stock-market-today-live-updates-.html) . Its report is among the first of the earnings season. According to FactSet data cited by CNBC, S&P 500 third-quarter earnings are expected to grow about 30%.


### The Fed's rate path


According to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/08/fed-hike-inflation-samsung-lululemon-iea-oil.html) , the Fed minutes gave no indication of when the next hike might come. The Fed's next meetings are on October 28 and December 9. Tonight's weekly jobless claims could offer a read on the labor market.
